register.name: SIRER (via SILiAmb platform)
register.notes: The producer register is SIRER (Sistema Integrado de Registo Electrónico de Resíduos), accessed and declared through the SILiAmb platform (front-end siliambfe.apambiente.pt); operated by APA under Decree-Law 152-D/2017 art. 19 (confirmed on apambiente.pt 2026-08-16). Per-stream enrolment; registration number issued on certificate; annual declarations (correção for previous year + estimativa for current) due by 31 March. Producers without a Portuguese establishment, distance sellers included, must appoint a Portugal-established representative by written mandate.

pro.ecoModulation: ECAL (beverage cartons) 0.2784 and 'other materials' 0.2679 dear; steel (0.1985) much higher than aluminium (0.0658). Same €/kg applies across sales/service/secondary/transport packaging.

notes: Rates from Sociedade Ponto Verde's official 'Tabela de Valores Ponto Verde (VPV)' annual table (fetched and parsed 2026-08-16, €/kg excl.
